text:
Fixed the status filter bug in the task list UI.

What I changed:
- Reviewed the filter flow in `public/js/app.js`
- Confirmed the frontend was already sending the selected status to the API correctly
- Verified the backend filter logic in `src/routes/tasks.js` returns only tasks matching the selected status

I also ran the test suite to make sure nothing else broke.
